##### Project general facts

Palatium Residence by Ahmadyar Developments is a contemporary residential building that rises above a ground floor and a multi-level parking podium. The project offers studio, one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, complemented by retail units at ground level. Every home is designed around refined everyday living, with advanced smart home automation, generous natural light and views over the surrounding community and its green parks. Professional maintenance services support residents and keep the building in excellent condition.

Residents have access to a swimming pool and a fully equipped gym, providing space to relax, exercise and recharge without leaving the building. The pool area offers a calm setting for unwinding at the end of the day, while the gym supports an active daily routine. Retail units at ground level add everyday convenience, and the building's compact, well-planned layout keeps shared facilities easy to reach for all residents.

Apartments feature high ceilings and expansive wall-to-wall windows that fill living spaces with daylight. Interiors combine elegant porcelain tiles, quality woodwork and high-end branded fittings for a calm, sophisticated atmosphere. Kitchens are fitted with sleek appliances, and en-suite bedrooms provide private retreats. Smart home automation adds comfort and control throughout each residence. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Circle is a master-planned community at the heart of new Dubai, known for its circular layout, tree-lined streets and numerous parks. It brings together villas, townhouses and apartment buildings in a family-friendly setting, offering a calmer pace of life while staying close to the city's main business and leisure districts. Landmarks such as JVC Castle Park and nearby hotels add to the neighbourhood's appeal.

Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connect the community with Dubai Marina, Mall of the Emirates, Dubai Hills, Palm Jumeirah and Downtown Dubai. Circle Mall serves as a local hub for shopping and dining, and residents have schools, nurseries, clinics, supermarkets and fitness centres across the community.

Jumeirah Village Circle is a freehold community and one of Dubai's most actively traded residential areas. Strong demand from young professionals and families supports high rental yields and steady occupancy. A central position, mature infrastructure and a wide choice of homes keep the area popular with both investors and end users.
